name: research_findings
title: Research findings
description: Research or analysis readout: headline findings, method, one finding per slide with its evidence, quotes, implications, limitations, next steps.
storyline: Headline findings first; then the method in one slide so the audience trusts the rest; then one finding per slide, each title the finding itself.

slots.title: <What we found, in one sentence>
slots.guidance: 3-5 findings with their numbers; the implication of each.

slots.title: <How we found it: sample and period>
slots.guidance: Sample size, period, method, and what it can and cannot show.

slots.title: <Finding, stated as a sentence>
slots.guidance: One finding per slide with the chart that proves it; source, n and period on the slide.

slots.title: <What participants said>
slots.guidance: A representative quote with who said it (role, not name).

slots.title: <What this means for us>
slots.guidance: The decisions or changes the findings point to.

slots.title: Next steps: who does what by when
slots.guidance: Columns Action | Owner | Due. One row per commitment; a named owner and a date on every row.
